adversarial_classes.malformed_input: Applicable and tested: schema tests reject malformed UUID, unknown/missing payment statuses, and nonpositive token counts; signature tests reject missing, uppercase, malformed, and raw-body-mismatched signatures. Invalid signatures return 401 without payment or ledger rows.
adversarial_classes.stale_state: Applicable and tested: identical terminal duplicates are no-ops; pending-to-succeeded credits once; terminal status changes and changed payment identity return 409; failed and pending events do not credit.
adversarial_classes.dirty_worktree: Applicable and checked: initial target worktree status showed only pre-existing modified .omo/plans/integer-generator-service.md; it was not edited or staged. Stage only the eight listed task-4 files.
adversarial_classes.hung_or_long_commands: Applicable and tested: database health readiness bounded by Compose healthcheck; live curl requests use --max-time 5; test and check commands complete without polling loops.
adversarial_classes.flaky_tests: Applicable and tested: twenty simultaneous HTTP requests use independent AsyncSessions and an engine pool_size of 20; asyncio.gather provides deterministic completion, with no sleeps or polling.
adversarial_classes.misleading_success_output: Applicable and tested: raw HTTP status lines/bodies were captured, pytest exits were captured, and a PostgreSQL join verified one successful payment identity and one +7 ledger credit.
adversarial_classes.prompt_injection: N/A: this implementation has no model or external prompt/tool path.
adversarial_classes.cancel_resume: N/A: this implementation adds no resumable workflow.
adversarial_classes.repeated_interruptions: N/A: no interruption loop or retrying background process is introduced.
